title: ObjectGenericDAE: massMatrixUserFunction, constraintUserFunction and jacobianUserFunction
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG9.10.6 (#3143, docs/dev/design/genericDAE.md section 2): massMatrixUserFunction(mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t, y, parameters) instead of the constant mass matrix; constraintUserFunction(mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t, y, z, velocityLevel, parameters), added to the algebraic equations; jacobianUserFunction(mbs, t, itemNumber, q, q_t, y, z, factorODE2, factorODE2_t, factorODE1, parameters), the local Jacobian of the terms of all user functions. A recorded constraintUserFunction gives its Jacobian blocks by the one-pass derivative, a Python one needs the jacobianUserFunction (no numerical Jacobian, #3101); SymbolicSystem takes the recorded mass matrix and constraint functions.
releaseNotes: ObjectGenericDAE has a massMatrixUserFunction, a constraintUserFunction of q, q_t, y and the multipliers z, added to its algebraic equations, and a jacobianUserFunction of the derivatives of all its user functions; a recorded constraintUserFunction gives its Jacobian in one pass, a Python one needs the jacobianUserFunction; SymbolicSystem takes the recorded mass matrix and constraint functions.
